description: Synthetic portfolio, capacity, cost and disruption parameters for the network planning engine. Lane geometry, base freight rates and lead times are read from asml/config.json and marvell/config.json; emission factors from data_sources/selected_emission_factors.json. Every value in this file is a scenario assumption, not company data.

asml.label: ASML-inspired spare parts, Netherlands to Singapore

red_sea.description: Red Sea diversion via the Cape of Good Hope for departures in weeks 4-12: ocean lead time +2 weeks, distance x1.4183 (21,770 km / 15,349 km, Port of Rotterdam figures in data_sources/data_audit_asml.md), ocean capacity -30% and surcharge x1.6; air spot capacity -40% and spot price x1.8 as shippers move to air. Capacity and price factors are illustrative.

air_crunch.description: Air cargo capacity crunch in weeks 6-10: air spot capacity -60% and spot price x1.6. Illustrative.

demand_surge.description: Fab ramp-up: committed demand +30% in weeks 8-16. Illustrative.

marvell.label: Marvell-inspired finished goods, Taiwan and Malaysia to Singapore

typhoon.description: Typhoon closes Taiwan ports in weeks 5-6 (ocean capacity 0) and halves Taiwan air spot capacity at x1.5 spot price. Illustrative.

border_congestion.description: Malaysia-Singapore border congestion in weeks 8-10: road lead time +1 week and road capacity -40%. Illustrative.

demand_surge.description: Customer ramp-up: committed demand +30% in weeks 8-16. Illustrative.
